name: Skill Recorder
tagline: Record a screen session, let Copilot turn it into a reusable Skill
description: Skill Recorder is a Microsoft project that records a screen session and lets Copilot reconstruct it as intent plus steps, producing a reusable Skill or Automation. Instead of hand-writing workflows, you demonstrate the action once on screen and get a repeatable artifact out. It targets turning manual, recorded procedures into agent-runnable automation.
highlights: Records a screen session as the source ground truth
Copilot reconstructs the session into intent and step sequences
Outputs reusable Skill or Automation artifacts
Turns demonstrated manual procedures into agent-runnable workflows
curatorNote: Example-driven automation is a compelling UX — demonstrating a task once and getting a persistent Skill is a natural bridge from demo to durable agent capability.
